desc.en: Recite the ziyarat of Prophet Hud & Sahle (a) in Waadi-us-Salaam…
desc.rurdu: Waadi-us-Salaam mein Nabi Hud o Sahle (a) ki ziyarat is tarah se padhe…

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰی اَوْلِیَآئِ اللهِ وَاَصْفِیَآئِهِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰی اُمَنَآئِ اللهِ وَاَحِبَّائِهِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰی اَنْصَارِ اللهِ وَخُلَفَآئِهِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰی مَحَآلِّ مَعْرِفَۃِ اللهِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰی مَسَاكِنِ ذِكْرِ اللهِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰی مُظْهِرِیْ اَمْرِ اللهِ وَ نَهْیِهٖ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَی الدُّعَاۃِ اِلَی اللهِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَی الْمُسْتَقِرِّیْنَ فِیْ مَرْضَاتِ اللهِ۔

lines.rarabic: AS-SALAAMO A’LAA AWLIYYAA-ILLAAHE WA ASFE-YAAA-E-HE. AS-SALAAMO A’LAA OMANAAA-ILLAAHE WA A-JIBBAA-E-HE. AS-SALAAMO A’LAA ANSAARIL-LAAHE. AS-SALAAMO A’LAA MA-HAALLE MA’RE-FATIL LAAHE. AS-SALAAMO A’LAA MASAA-KENE ZIKRIL-LAAHE. AS-SALAAMO A’LAA MUZHE-REE AMRIL-LAAHE WA NAHYE-HI. AS-SALAAMO A’LAD DO-AA’TE ILAL-LAAHE. AS-SALAAMO A’LAL MUSTAQIR-REENA FEE MARZAATIL-LAAHE.

trans.en: Peace be upon the close servants of Allah and His chosen ones. Peace be upon the trustees of Allah and His beloved. Peace be upon the helpers of Allah and His representatives. Peace be upon the place of recognition of Allah. Peace upon the abodes of the remembrance of Allah. Peace be upon the promulgators of Allah’s orders and His prohibitions. Peace be upon the callers to Allah. Peace be upon those who are steadfast in paths of Allah’s pleasure.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَی الْمُخْلِصِیْنَ فِیْ طَاعَۃِ اللهِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَی الْاَدِلَّائِ عَلَی اللهِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَی الَّذِیْنَ مَنْ وَالَاهُمْ فَقَدْ اِلَی اللهَ، وَ مَنْ عَادَاهُمْ فَقَدْ عَادَی اللهَ، وَمَنْ عَرَفَهُمْ فَقَدْ عَرَفَ اللهَ، وَمَنْ جَهِلَهُمْ فَقَدْ جَهِلَ اللهَ، وَمَنِّ اعْتَصَمَ بِهِمْ فَقَدِ اعْتَصَمَ بِاللهِ، وَمَنْ تَخَلَّی مِنْهُمْ فَقَدْ تَخَلَّی مِنَ اللهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ۔

lines.rarabic: AS-SALAAMO A’LAL MUKHLE-SEENA FEE TAA-A’TIL LAAHE. AS-SALAAMO A’LAL ADILLAA-E A’LAL-LAAHE. AS-SALAAMO A’LAL LAZEENA MAN WAALAA-HUM FA-QAD ILAL-LAAHA, WA MAN AA’DAA-HUM FA-QAD AA’DAL-LAAHA, WA MAN A’RAFA-HUM FA-QAD ARAFAL-LAAHA, WA MAN JAHELA-HUM FA-QAD JAHE-LAL-LAAHA, WA MANNE’ TASAMA BEHIM FA-QADE’ TASAMA BILLAAHE, WA MAN TA-KHALLA MIN-HUM FA-QAD TA-KHALLA MINALLAAHE A’ZZA WA JALLA.

trans.en: Peace be upon those who are dedicated in obedience to Allah. Peace be upon the guides to Allah. Peace be upon them; whose friends are Allah’s friends whose enemies are Allah’s enemies who know them know Allah who is ignorant of them is indeed ignorant about Allah who holds fast to them then indeed he has held fast to Allah who forsakes them then indeed he has forsaken Allah, the Almighty and Majestic.

arabic.text: وَاُشْهِدُ اللهَ اَنِّیْ سِلْمٌ لِمَنْ سَالَمْتُمْ وَ حَرْبٌ لِمَنْ حَارَبْتُمْ مُؤْمِنٌ بِسِرِّكُمْ وَعَلَا نِیَّتِكُمْ مُفَوِّضٌ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ كُلِّهٖ اِلَیْكُمْ لَعَنَ اللهُ عَدُوَّ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْاِنْسِ وَاَبْرَئُ اِلَی اللهِ مِنْهُمْ وَصَلَّی اللهُ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِهِ۔

lines.rarabic: WA USHHE-DUL LAAHA ANNEE SILMOON LEMAN SAALAM-TUM WA HARBOON LEMAN HAARAB-TUM MO-MENOON BE-SIRRE-KUM WA A’LAA NIYYATE-KUM MOFAWWE-ZOON FEE ZAALEKA KULLE-HI ILAI-KUM LA-A’NAL-LAAHO A’DOOWA AALE MOHAMMADIN MINAL JINNE WAL INSE WA ABRA-O ILALAAHE MIN-HUM WA SALAL-LAAHO A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE-HI.

trans.en: O Allah I bear witness, I am at peace with the one who is at peace with you and at war with the one who is at war with you, believing in your esoteric and exoteric affairs, delegating all this to you. May Allah banish from His mercy the enemies of the family of Muhammad, from jinn and humans. I disassociate from them before Allah.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
